title.zh: prepare 脚本编码硬化（ASCII-only 或 BOM）+ 日志补 exit/sha 摘要
title.en: Harden the prepare scripts encoding (ASCII-only or BOM) and add exit/sha summary lines to the logs

intent.zh: 处理存量隐患：`scripts/prepare-cuda-probe.ps1` 与 `scripts/prepare-native-probe.ps1` 是 UTF-8 无 BOM 且含中文，Windows PowerShell 5.1 按 ANSI 解析会崩（实测 prepare-cuda 7 个解析错误、prepare-native 1 个解析错误），瘦身恢复时只能用同目录 BOM 临时副本绕过。硬化方案：优先把两个脚本改成 ASCII-only（与 run-window.ps1 的既有做法一致），或退而加 UTF-8 BOM；同时给脚本输出补 exit code 与 sha 校验摘要行（当前日志无 sha 行/exit 码，QA 复核时无法从日志直接确认脚本自带校验结果）。边界：只改这两个脚本与其输出；不改 toolchain 版本/sha 期望/下载源/安装内容。验证：用 PowerShell 解析器做语法检查（不执行下载）+ 若重复运行应跳过已存在的组件并输出 sha/exit 摘要。
intent.en: Fix the standing hazard: scripts/prepare-cuda-probe.ps1 and scripts/prepare-native-probe.ps1 are UTF-8 without BOM and contain CJK, so Windows PowerShell 5.1 mis-parses them (measured: 7 parser errors for cuda, 1 for native); the slim recovery had to use a same-directory BOM copy. Harden by making both scripts ASCII-only (matching the existing run-window.ps1 practice) or, failing that, adding a UTF-8 BOM; also add exit-code and sha-verification summary lines to their output (current logs carry no sha lines and no exit code). Boundary: only those two scripts and their output; toolchain versions, sha expectations, download sources and installed contents are unchanged. Verify with the PowerShell parser (syntax only, no download) and a repeat run that skips existing components and prints sha/exit summaries.

acceptance: 两个 prepare 脚本在 Windows PowerShell 5.1 下语法解析通过（Parser::ParseFile 0 错误）；脚本为 ASCII-only（或 UTF-8 BOM），不再依赖临时副本。
脚本输出包含每次运行的 exit code 与脚本自带 sha256 校验摘要（组件名 + 期望/实际 sha 或 SHA_VERIFIED 计数），日志可直接复核；重复运行跳过已存在组件的行为不变。
只改 `scripts/prepare-cuda-probe.ps1`、`scripts/prepare-native-probe.ps1`（及其日志输出）；toolchain 版本/sha 期望/下载源/安装内容不变；`src/`、`tests/`、判据数值、清单、参考、fixtures 零改动。
note: Arch 2026-11-02 注册（proposed，先不动手）。来源：QA 最终复核观察——瘦身恢复时 PS 5.1 对两个 prepare 脚本分别报 7/1 个解析错误，只能靠 BOM 临时副本执行；日志也无 sha 行/exit 码，QA 复核不便。

addenda.reason: QA 观察 1：把一次幂等实跑日志归档并记录复现——logs/prepare-cuda-idempotent.txt（EXIT=0、11.1s，含 PREPARE_CUDA_SUMMARY 与 8 条 sha 行）、logs/prepare-native-idempotent.txt（EXIT=0、3.5s，含 PREPARE_NATIVE_SUMMARY）；QA 已独立实跑复现 CUDA EXIT=0/13.3s、native EXIT=0/4.8s；repo-slim manifest 重算 5 项。不改脚本/数值。
